versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart E — Power-Plant Installations; Reciprocating Engines
versions.text: A throttle control shall be provided to give independent control for each engine. Throt- tle controls shall afford a positive and immediately responsive means of controlling the engine(s). Throttle controls shall be grouped and arranged in such a manner as to permit separate control of each engine and also simultaneous control of all engines.
